author: Spread
name: Pills
description: Six pills that fill from the left, the value beside them (bars of pressure, signal, stock).
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 240 52"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.off rect{fill:currentColor;fill-opacity:.14}.on rect{fill:#3b82f6}.mk{fill:#fff;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(var(--v))}.big{font-size:26px;fill:#3b82f6}.cap{text-anchor:start}</style><defs><mask id="pm"><rect class="mk" x="0" y="0" width="160" height="40"/></mask></defs><g class="off"><rect x="4" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="30" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="56" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="82" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="108" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="134" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/></g><g class="on" mask="url(#pm)"><rect x="4" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="30" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="56" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="82" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="108" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/><rect x="134" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="6"/></g>
<text x="176" y="27" class="num big">{{value}}</text><text x="4" y="46" class="cap" style="font-size:11px">{{label}}</text></svg>
